turns.input: Hadrik Voss gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration: Hadrik Voss reaches behind his broad frame and withdraws a worn pair of leather boots, holding them up for inspection. He turns them in his calloused hands, checking the stitching at the sole with practiced habit, the small rectangular lenses on his nose catching the daylight. His attention stays on the boots rather than Nicco's face. After a moment he lowers them, still gripping them in both hands, and gives a short shake of his head. "Not these," he says. "Wrong leather for your weight. Would split inside a month." He tucks the boots back behind him and folds his thick arms, lenses still in place as he studies Nicco's bulk with the mild, measuring look of a man who sees structural problems before social ones.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Nicco looks at the boots in his hands, then back at the dwarf. "Thanks," he says, "but you'll need them more than me." He extends them back toward Hadrik.

Hadrik's brows rise slightly above his magnifying lenses. He sets down the small tool he'd been reaching for and turns fully to face Nicco for the first time. "You certain?" His gaze drops to the boots, then back up. "They're not charity. I made them for you, sized and all." He does not take them yet, leaving the decision open. "Ill-fitting boots are worse than none. You'll know that soon enough if you walk Calderan's streets." The traffic in Heartstone Square continues around them, a few passersby glancing at the pair standing before the tower's heavy entrance.
